subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Is there any portal to __redeem__ these coupons that I have collected from the store?
solution:
The correct answer is "**forfeit**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word "redeem" means to exchange something for a reward or benefit.**(भुनाना)

 
 
• ​Example: She is going to redeem her ring.
 
 
 
• ​**The word "forfeit" means to lose or give up something as a penalty.**(ज़ब्‍ती, दंड-भराई)
 
 
• ​Example: The Bench ordered that the net and rabbits should be forfeit.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the words, "redeem" and "forfeit" are antonyms.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Forsake**" means to abandon or give up on something/someone.(त्यागना)
 
• "**Deplore**" means to strongly disapprove or condemn something.(विलाप करना)
 
• "**Embezzle**" means to steal or misappropriate funds.(ग़बन करना)
